create_timer_context_manager: create a Timer context manager that prints elapsed time on exit
create_timer_manual: create a Timer instance and call since_start to get total elapsed time
use_since_last_check: use since_last_check on a Timer to measure time between checkpoints
use_check_time: use check_time with a timer_id to log elapsed time at loop checkpoints
create_timer_with_template: create a Timer with a custom print template string for formatted output
